title: lunathyrium henryi
intro: Lunathyrium henryi, commonly known as the Himalayan Lungwort, is a species of flowering plant in the fern family (Thelypteridaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties that help to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs. The therapeutic actions of Lunathyrium henryi include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic, which can help to soothe and protect the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
